governing_plan: .claude/learned_search_v02.md 'MORPHEUS Downstream' Sections 5, 7, 8; coordinator decision 2026-10-21 after the G18 7b diagnosis
status: FROZEN before any blind finding arrives; canonical hash in dbench/protocols/assay_distillation_v03.sha256; assay_distillation_v02 stays on record

supersedes.reason: 7b(ii) on G18: a state locked with per-patient intercepts has zero between-patient variance by construction (share 0.000), so a patient-level bulk proxy and the 7a success rule can never be met for any such finding whatever the student; the fix is in the protocol (which state each claim uses), not in the analysis

state_definitions.rule: every finding carries two state definitions, both frozen at the characterisation lock and recorded in the state card field state_definitions with their canonical hashes (dbench.downstream.locks.StateCard.set_state_definitions)

a_within_patient.definition: the state as locked in the relation/characterisation (per-patient intercepts: within-patient centring of target, candidates, covariates; for a residual programme, the frozen loading on the covariate-adjusted residual after within-patient centring)
not_eligible_for: Section 5 patient-level comparisons stated as translation

b_between_patient_inclusive.definition: the same frozen projection without per-patient intercepts (relation: f_S applied to support-standardised, not within-centred, candidates; residual programme: the frozen loading on the covariate-adjusted residual with a single intercept)
eligible_for: 7a bulk translation and its success rule
b_between_patient_inclusive.card_enforcement: a distillation 7a result or a clinical result must carry state_definition_hash equal to the hash of (b); a result computed on (a) is rejected by the card writer

ladder.7a_primary: unchanged from v02 except that the target is state (b); students trained on spatial patients only; success = best student TCGA pooled Spearman > 0.3 with patient-bootstrap CI above the permuted-target null q95 and within-site-centred Spearman above the available STPath / DeepSpot baselines
ladder.7b_diagnosis: reported, never gated: (i) held-out spot Spearman on state (a) and on state (b), each with the permuted-target null, and the patient-level Spearman with its 2000-draw patient-bootstrap 95% interval beside it; (ii) between-patient variance share of state (b) (the share of (a) is 0 by construction and is not reported as a finding); (iii) slide agreement split by preparation class (TCGA DX FFPE; CPTAC tumor_tissue_collection_frozen_with_oct)
ladder.7c_bulk_anchored: unchanged from v02, computed against the bulk score of state (b); separate card block; never called spatial-to-bulk transfer

small_sample_note: the discovery cohort has 24 patients: a patient-level Spearman has a very wide interval (for example the G18 state (b) held-out patient Spearman -0.51 carries the bootstrap interval reported beside it and is not interpreted alone); patient-level numbers are always reported with that interval
deepspot: unchanged from v02 (launch script dbench/downstream/scripts/deepspot_inference.sh; deferred until the GPU is free after the freeze; kidney model trained on HEST data that includes the discovery cohort)
gates: 7a success on state (b) is the only declared success rule; 7b and 7c are reported, never gated
